div.div:
ca-api Python 3.12 · FastAPI
• Microsoft Agent Framework 1.24 — workflows:
Express · Complete · Fraud investigation
• Fraud branches in parallel: images + C2PA,
declaration vs evidence, Web IQ check (FR/CH)
• Time & token budgets · one targeted re-extraction
• Next best action + human decision (HITL)
• Policy RAG FR/CH (pgvector) · stable API contract
